title: Fixed Open Drum and Front Pan Coffee Roaster
description: One newly authored complete fixed coffee-roaster-style machine exterior. A long four-foot common base carries a thick horizontal barrel with a genuinely open front chamber, separate full rear end and fixed side-open circular front door. A deep opaque top feed hopper has a real empty blind chamber, without a claimed hidden feed connection. A short open-topped discharge chute leads visually toward a separately supported low circular front pan with its complete floor/rim, central spindle and three full blunt radial sweep pieces. A true open-ended rear elbow and one blank side control complete the whole apparatus. No old winnower, grinder or drum geometry imported or rescaled; the open barrel and front pan are distinct connected stages of one static object. One prop zero scenes, three opaque constant PBR materials. No beans, combustion/heating, roasting or cooling performance, airflow, rotation, continuous processing passage, electrical operation, food handling/hygiene procedure, manufacture or safety certification. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
